canonical_definition: The world as it exists independently of OuttaMyWay observation or interpretation.
observations_or_inputs: World state exists independently of the system.
knowledge_output: Reference truth against which observations and knowledge are judged.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Recent actuator-response tests reinforced that declared intent is not realised reality.
notes: Do not equate logs, requests or predictions with realised state.

canonical_definition: A sampled fact about Reality; observations may be incomplete, delayed or uncertain.
observations_or_inputs: GIANTS state, transforms, motion, field data, control outcomes.
knowledge_output: Raw factual evidence for interpretation.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: v4.6.44-49 controllers consumed many observations directly.
notes: The issue is ownership, not absence of observations.

canonical_definition: The system’s evolving estimate of Reality reconstructed from observations.
observations_or_inputs: Observations plus interpretation and confidence.
knowledge_output: Decision-consumable understanding.
intended_consumer: Decision Engine and other knowledge consumers
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Temporary controllers often retained derived knowledge privately.
notes: Knowledge must not be recreated independently by each controller.

canonical_definition: The single current interpretation of decision-relevant observations maintained by Situation Assessment; Knowledge, not Reality.
observations_or_inputs: Current observations, retained relationships, confidence, constraints and outcomes.
knowledge_output: Coherent present operational understanding.
implementation_state_v4_6_43: No single active shared object governs TS015/016
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Observation Ownership and continuation evidence exposed fragmented private pictures.
notes: Terminology remains unresolved, but ownership is not unresolved.

canonical_definition: The structured set of possible situations relevant to autonomous work, including entities, states and relationships.
observations_or_inputs: Observed entities, environment, relationships and state possibilities.
knowledge_output: The domain within which Current Situation is estimated.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Recent failures show that private phase models represented only subsets of Situation Space.
notes: Conditions was explicitly rejected as a separate root concept.

canonical_definition: The set of plausible future situations currently under consideration; multiple possibilities are preserved.
observations_or_inputs: Current motion, local intent, configuration changes, plausible manoeuvres and uncertainty.
knowledge_output: Plausible future occupancy and situation alternatives.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Future Corridor Frame and refuge-occupancy conflict refine how Future Space must persist through geometry change.
notes: Do not collapse Future Space to one route or current heading.

canonical_definition: The set of actions currently available to an entity or system.
observations_or_inputs: Current situation, constraints, capability model and time.
knowledge_output: Available alternatives and preserved options.
natural_owner: Situation Assessment supplies permitted space; Decision selects
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Temporal and manoeuvre reserves quantify part of Action Space.
notes: Option preservation is a purpose of anticipation.

canonical_definition: Interprets observations, maintains the most plausible Current Situation, represents risk, uncertainty, constraints and permitted responses; issues no control.
observations_or_inputs: All observations, including control and recovery outcomes.
knowledge_output: Operational Picture Knowledge, confidence, constraints, relevance and readiness.
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Canonical concept; active experimental path bypasses it
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: v4.6.44-49 controllers interpreted raw state and selected actions.
notes: This is the central recovery boundary.

canonical_status: Named canonical discovery; definition not recovered
canonical_definition: Named as a v4.3.8 architectural discovery, but no current canonical definition was found.
observations_or_inputs: Not explicitly specified in authoritative current text.
knowledge_output: Likely whether sufficient knowledge exists for Decision, but this is inference and not adopted here.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Recent unknown/clear/blocked gates demonstrate the need for an explicit readiness conclusion.
notes: Do not invent a definition until prior source or owner intent is recovered.
v4_6_50_disposition: RETIRED — use action/conclusion-specific Sufficiency over Completeness.

canonical_status: Named canonical discovery; definition not recovered
canonical_definition: Named as a v4.3.8 architectural discovery, but no current canonical definition was found.
observations_or_inputs: Not explicitly specified.
knowledge_output: Not explicitly specified.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Persistent completed workers, field boundary and refuge occupancy indicate expected scope.
notes: Likely related to Relevance Envelope, but equivalence is unproven.
v4_6_50_disposition: RETIRED — Decision evaluates material Operational Picture Knowledge relative to candidate action and Commitment.

canonical_status: Named canonical discovery; partial meaning elsewhere
canonical_definition: Named in ADR-0003; later documents define many concrete constraints but not one consolidated contract.
observations_or_inputs: Field, geometry, support, capability, commitments, uncertainty.
knowledge_output: Constraints within which all valid actions must exist.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Refuge Viability Gate implemented one local subset.
notes: The concept exists; the missing part is one enforceable contract.
v4_6_50_disposition: RETIRED AS STANDALONE OUTPUT — preserve explicit constraint Knowledge, mandatory applicability and admissibility.

canonical_status: Named canonical discovery; definition not recovered
canonical_definition: Named as a v4.3.8 architectural discovery, but no current canonical definition was found.
observations_or_inputs: Not explicitly specified.
knowledge_output: Not explicitly specified.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Observation Ownership and Persistent Situation Relevance appear to be operational evidence for it.
notes: Recover before adding a new duplicate concept.
v4_6_50_disposition: RETIRED — Situation Assessment remains aware of the complete Field World; use Situation Relevance and Operational Picture.

canonical_status: Named canonical discovery; definition not recovered
canonical_definition: Named as a v4.3.8 architectural discovery, but no current canonical definition was found.
observations_or_inputs: Not explicitly specified.
knowledge_output: Not explicitly specified.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Response Margin and Temporal Separation Reserve may be evidence representations within it.
notes: Do not equate automatically with Action Space or Continuation Safety Horizon.
v4_6_50_disposition: RETIRED AS STANDALONE OBJECT — preserve Option Preservation and action-specific expiry in Action Space.

canonical_definition: Authoritative report of what Control attempted, what effect was observed and what capability was demonstrated or disproved.
observations_or_inputs: Control attempt, selected setpoint, motor response, physical response, failure or partial success.
knowledge_output: Updated operational truth and capability evidence.
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Architecture accepted; telemetry uneven before v4.6.45
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Declared Cap Is Not Applied Cap directly validated this contract.
notes: Speed actuator telemetry is a good reusable example.

canonical_definition: Validated account of influence currently available to the system.
observations_or_inputs: Outcome observations and native capability evidence.
knowledge_output: What Control can actually realise now.
natural_owner: Situation Assessment maintains from feedback; Control demonstrates
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Persistent Speed Authority and permission-gate hold are validated capabilities.
notes: Capabilities should be consumed by Decision, not promoted into policy.

canonical_definition: A persistent intention with creation, maintenance, completion and cancellation lifecycle; Situation Assessment supplies validity evidence.
observations_or_inputs: Decision result, assumptions, obligations, continuing knowledge and outcomes.
knowledge_output: Stable decision intent until maintained, completed, revised or cancelled.
intended_consumer: Control capabilities; Situation Assessment evaluates evidence
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Private run/episode state substitutes for shared ownership
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Protected handoff and commitment viability decay exposed fragmented ownership.
notes: A ledger/schema is missing; the concept is not.

canonical_definition: A spatial-temporal region where intended motion cannot safely coexist without coordination.
observations_or_inputs: Current and plausible future occupancy relationships.
knowledge_output: Derived conflict relationship, not a root primitive.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: TS015/016 confirm conflicts evolve across geometry changes.
notes: Do not treat one geometry snapshot as the encounter.

canonical_status: Deferred concepts with strong passive evidence
canonical_definition: Separate per-entity motion stability from relationship-level persistent projected conflict.
observations_or_inputs: Motion history, turn state, tCPA/dCPA persistence and movement stability.
knowledge_output: FORMING versus established conflict knowledge, with uncertainty preserved.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Recent controllers used direct thresholds but did not consume one shared confidence result.
notes: Thresholds remain diagnostic, not architecture.

canonical_definition: Dynamic relationship by which a Field World Member can affect an Operation member or a plausible future.
observations_or_inputs: Current occupancy, plausible future space, operation demand and time horizon.
knowledge_output: Whether an entity/relationship remains relevant for assessment.
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Field World probes retain some relevance
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Observation Ownership and post-passage continuation are refinements, not a new root responsibility.
notes: Relevance can persist after passing, stopping, completion or loss of immediate intervention need.

canonical_definition: Physical geometry intersects the bounded Field World; does not imply participation, agency or relevance.
observations_or_inputs: Field polygon and physical geometry.
knowledge_output: Membership classification independent of worker state.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Field-edge refuge failure demonstrated that membership alone does not enforce containment.
notes: Membership and containment are separate.

canonical_definition: Dynamic participation in a specific Operation; physical presence or influence alone is insufficient.
observations_or_inputs: GIANTS job state, recognised work behaviour and operation relationship.
knowledge_output: Participating/not participating plus transitions.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Completed Condor remained relevant after membership ended.
notes: Do not remove non-members from the world model.

canonical_definition: Whether an Entity currently affects progress, options or completion; broader than participation.
observations_or_inputs: Occupancy, operation demand, progress effects and future space.
knowledge_output: Influential/not influential relationship.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Repeated local fixes and completed obstacles show influence persists beyond active pair admission.
notes: Useful bridge from local encounter to Operation-level reasoning.

canonical_definition: Connected runtime entities/components whose combined state determines working behaviour, occupancy, future movement, transitions and control response.
observations_or_inputs: Attachment structure, source/runtime identity, pose, configuration and control response.
knowledge_output: Which members matter to current assessment and their combined behaviour.
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Strong representation research; active control partly fixture-specific
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Refuge and speed behavior confirms assembly-level, not vehicle-name-level, authority is needed.
notes: Architecture is generic even when fixture code is not.

canonical_definition: Relational, directional conclusion that current occupancy, expected movement or changing geometry constrains another entity or Operation.
observations_or_inputs: Entity occupancy/Future Space + assessed demand + time horizon.
knowledge_output: Obstacle-relevance relationship; may precede intersection.
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Some passive evidence; no unified consumer
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Patriot’s turn into occupied refuge was observed as changing obstacle relevance but not consumed by the owning controller.
notes: Obstacle is not a semantic type.

canonical_definition: Whether a GIANTS AI job configuration lies within the supported control-investigation envelope; not runtime permission.
observations_or_inputs: Semantic catalogue, base-game capability evidence and job configuration.
knowledge_output: Supported/unresolved/excluded profile.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Recent fixture controllers bypass generic eligibility.
notes: Keep separate from physical relevance.

canonical_definition: Whether a proposed intervention may target this runtime Entity now, considering profile, state, operation, capability, commitments and action.
observations_or_inputs: Control Eligibility Profile + runtime state + Operation context + proposed intervention.
knowledge_output: Admissible/inadmissible/unresolved for a specific action now.
natural_owner: Decision Engine using Situation Assessment knowledge
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Refuge Viability Gate was a local action-specific admissibility subset.
notes: A universal gate is missing, not the concept.

canonical_definition: Authoritative Operational Picture knowledge forbidding unsupported intervention while retaining representation.
observations_or_inputs: Known control ineligibility.
knowledge_output: Hard exclusion for downstream selection.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Unknown Is Not Reachable is analogous for refuge candidates.
notes: Exclusion should be explicit and scoped.

canonical_definition: Simultaneous component, convex, member, assembly and unknown occupancy representations; fitness depends on question.
observations_or_inputs: Physical identity, geometry, pose, fallbacks and unknown regions.
knowledge_output: Layered occupancy evidence with provenance and limits.
natural_owner: Representation providers; Situation Assessment judges fitness
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Temporary refuge selector promoted some fallbacks into authority locally.
notes: Coarse complete evidence can be safer than precise incomplete evidence.

canonical_definition: Each representation declares spatial core, validity context and evidence quality/claim permissions.
observations_or_inputs: Geometry, ownership, pose, state, provenance, completeness, conservatism and fitness.
knowledge_output: Self-describing evidence usable without reconstructing discovery mechanics.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: v4.6.49 logged provenance but active eligibility did not centrally enforce all fitness classes.
notes: This is the basis for preventing diagnostic evidence becoming control truth.

canonical_definition: Situation Assessment decides whether evidence is currently fit, horizon-limited, uncertain, stale or invalid; unresolved response remains Decision concern.
observations_or_inputs: Representation passports, dependencies, age, changes and assessment horizon.
knowledge_output: Fitness state and permitted conclusion.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Refuge selector and controller made local fitness/authority decisions.
notes: Fitness and cost are separate.

canonical_definition: All collision-relevant plan-view occupancy is represented for a stated subject/state; closure basis, gaps, risk and freshness are recorded.
observations_or_inputs: Inventory, templates, poses, enclosures and unresolved regions.
knowledge_output: Structural/realised closure status and ledger.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Refuge calculations used bounded compact approximations without general complete closure.
notes: Known components do not prove complete coverage.

canonical_name: Conflict Excluded / Supported / Possible / Clearance Unresolved
canonical_definition: Layered knowledge states based on coverage, conservatism and current evidence; uncertainty removes all-clear authority but does not invent collision.
observations_or_inputs: Realised coverage and relative occupancy/projection.
knowledge_output: Scoped occupancy conclusion with uncertainty.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Unknown Is Not Reachable correctly applied the same logic locally.
notes: Clearance Unresolved is knowledge, not an automatic hold.

canonical_definition: Deployment, vertical configuration, terrain contact, functional engagement and operational phase are independent dimensions.
observations_or_inputs: Live pose, animation, specialisations, AI phase and contact evidence.
knowledge_output: Current physical-state knowledge without universal animation semantics.
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Research evidence; controller still uses fold thresholds
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: The 0.15 egress-ready threshold risks collapsing diagnostic animation evidence into authority.
notes: Operational phase is not authoritative pose evidence.

canonical_definition: Deployment motion while base is stationary is distinct from translation/steering/articulation sweep; endpoint poses do not contain the transition necessarily.
observations_or_inputs: Current configuration, live geometry, steering mode and kinematics.
knowledge_output: Projected occupied area through transition or manoeuvre.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Refuge occupancy and turning collision demonstrate missing time-dependent sweep assessment.
notes: Do not substitute frame-by-frame reaction for pre-commitment assessment.

canonical_definition: Speeds and movement behaviours GIANTS normally demonstrates for a specific Behavioural Assembly.
observations_or_inputs: Observed GIANTS working, repositioning, steering and stopping behaviour.
knowledge_output: Assembly-specific normal movement capability.
natural_owner: Situation Assessment capability knowledge / Control capability
implementation_state_v4_6_43: Known for fixture but not consumed generically
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Native Repositioning Motion is a capability abstraction derived from this existing concept.
notes: 5/6/15 km/h phase literals should not become architecture.

canonical_name: Local Intent Horizon, Intent Expiry, Encounter Chain, Safe Release Point and Continuation Safety Horizon
canonical_definition: Current settled trajectory is locally useful, expires on new manoeuvre/detachment, and safe release requires a bounded continuation to remain clear; linked conflicts may persist.
observations_or_inputs: Motion settlement, subsequent manoeuvres, entity retention and future occupancy.
knowledge_output: Local intent validity, expiry, linked encounter knowledge and release-safety evidence.
evidence_v4_6_44_to_49: Post-passage guard, observation ownership, passage-vs-continuation and mutual continuation clearance substantially reinforce these concepts.
notes: The latest discoveries should be reconciled here before adding new roots.
